tool.title: The render pipeline, in dependency order
tool.description: Flatten the repository's renders into the order their `needs` imply, and optionally run them. Two stages: the current declared state as json/jsonld and the README derived from it are FATAL; the dynamic renderers (viewers, visualisers, doc pages, diagrams) skip and log; the dynamic-state export closes it. A cycle or a missing dependency yields NO order rather than a partial one.

inputs.name: dry_run
inputs.description: Print the flattened order and each step's failure policy without running anything.

outputs.name: report
outputs.description: Per step: ran, failed, skipped, or PENDING — declared with no implementation yet, which is never rendered as a pass.
